data.one_liner: Allows Flutter desktop apps to automatically launch on startup or login.
data.what_it_does: Provides an API to configure, enable, disable, and check the launch-at-startup status for Flutter desktop applications across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Windows, macOS, or Linux.
Your app needs the capability to start automatically when the user logs in or boots the system.
avoid_when: You are building for mobile or web platforms.
You do not want your app running in the background immediately upon user login.
strengths: Supports multiple desktop platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux).
Simple API to enable, disable, and check launch status.
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup on macOS (Swift package and build phase configuration).
Requires proper app info (such as app name and executable path) to function correctly.
data.setup_notes: Requires initialization code and platform-specific setup on macOS involving Xcode and Swift package dependencies.
